title: Asset class module
description: One asset class. Adding a class means adding a folder and this file — nothing central is edited, so a new tab cannot half-exist.

id.description: Also the folder name. A mismatch is rejected, so the two cannot drift. Deliberately a pattern rather than a list of the four classes that exist today — a closed list here would mean adding a class requires editing something central, which is the thing this design exists to avoid.

horizon_days.description: How long this class takes to give feedback. Housing is slow, FX is fast; scores are never compared across classes because of it.

seers.description: Fewer than two makes the class incomplete: a single seer has nothing to be wrong against, so its track record means nothing.

label_tr.description: The name shown in the interface, which is Turkish. Kept here rather than in the UI so that adding an asset class stays a matter of adding a folder — a label map in the code would be one more central edit.

order.description: Where this module sits in the tab strip. Explicit because the alternative is alphabetical by English id, which puts Hisse before Döviz and means nothing to a Turkish reader.
